ddl.head: alter table public.weekly_source_charge_checks owner to postgres;
alter table public.weekly_source_billing_movements owner to postgres;
create unique index weekly_source_billing_movements_report_row_uq on public.weekly_source_billing_movements(self_bill_report_row_id) where self_bill_report_row_id is not null;
create unique index weekly_source_billing_movements_vat_rounding_client_uq on public.weekly_source_billing_movements(vat_rounding_revision_id,actual_client_id) where vat_rounding_r
alter table public.weekly_source_billing_movements add column invoice_window_cycle_id uuid
alter table public.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_lines add column invoice_rounding_authority_json jsonb,

constraints.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (comparison_result = 'UNVERIFIABLE'::text OR source_commission_pence IS NOT NULL AND source_total_cost_pence IS NOT NULL AND source_shift_charge_pence IS NOT NULL AND calculated_segment_charge_pence IS NOT NULL AND source_charge_difference_pence IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (comparison_result <> 'SOURCE_ROUNDING_EQUIVALENT'::text OR (source_charge_difference_pence = ANY (ARRAY[1::bigint, '-1'::integer::bigint])) AND (source_shift_charge_pence > 0 AND calculated_segment_charge_pence > 0 OR source_shift_charge_pence < 0 AND calculated_segment_charge_pence < 0))

constraints.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK ((comparison_result = ANY (ARRAY['MISMATCH'::text, 'ZERO_SOURCE_CHARGE'::text, 'UNVERIFIABLE'::text])) OR blocker_code IS NULL)

constraints.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check7
constraints.definition: CHECK (comparison_result <> 'ZERO_SOURCE_CHARGE'::text OR source_commission_pence = 0 AND source_total_cost_pence = 0 AND source_shift_charge_pence = 0 AND calculated_segment_charge_pence <> 0 AND blocker_code IS NULL)

constraints.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check8
constraints.definition: CHECK (row_sign_kind <> 'POSITIVE'::text OR comparison_result = 'UNVERIFIABLE'::text OR source_commission_pence >= 0 AND source_total_cost_pence >= 0 AND (source_shift_charge_pence > 0 AND calculated_segment_charge_pence > 0 OR comparison_result = 'ZERO_SOURCE_CHARGE'::text AND source_shift_charge_pence = 0 AND calculated_segment_charge_pence > 0))

constraints.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check9
constraints.definition: CHECK (row_sign_kind <> 'FULL_NEGATIVE'::text OR comparison_result = 'UNVERIFIABLE'::text OR source_commission_pence <= 0 AND source_total_cost_pence <= 0 AND source_shift_charge_pence < 0 AND calculated_segment_charge_pence < 0)

independentRetainedChecks.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check
independentRetainedChecks.definition: CHECK (NOT source_shift_charge_pence IS DISTINCT FROM (source_commission_pence + source_total_cost_pence) OR source_commission_pence IS NULL OR source_total_cost_pence IS NULL)

independentRetainedChecks.name: weekly_source_charge_checks_check1
independentRetainedChecks.definition: CHECK (NOT source_charge_difference_pence IS DISTINCT FROM (source_shift_charge_pence - calculated_segment_charge_pence) OR source_shift_charge_pence IS NULL OR calculated_segment_charge_pence IS NULL)

constraints.name: weekly_source_billing_movements_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((transition_id IS NOT NULL)::integer + (nhsp_upload_row_id IS NOT NULL)::integer + (expense_authority_generation_id IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1)

constraints.name: weekly_source_billing_movements_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_profile_kind <> 'NHSP_TRUST_BACKING_REPORT'::text OR source_validation_charge_pence IS NOT NULL AND invoice_presentation_charge_pence = source_validation_charge_pence AND (price_check_result = ANY (ARRAY['EXACT'::text, 'SOURCE_ROUNDING_EQUIVALENT'::text, 'ACCEPTED_DISPARITY'::text, 'ACCEPTED_ZERO'::text])))

constraints.name: weekly_source_billing_movements_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_line_kind <> 'SOURCE_FIXED_EXPENSE'::text OR source_validation_charge_pence IS NOT NULL AND invoice_presentation_charge_pence = source_validation_charge_pence AND price_check_result = 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text)

constraints.name: weekly_source_billing_movements_check7
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_profile_kind = 'NHSP_TRUST_BACKING_REPORT'::text OR (price_check_result = ANY (ARRAY['NOT_APPLICABLE'::text, 'EXACT'::text, 'SOURCE_ROUNDING_EQUIVALENT'::text])) AND charge_acceptance_id IS NULL)
